name: MAIRE TECNIMONT SPA MAIRE TECNI
summary: Maire Tecnimont S.p.A. is an Italian engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) contractor focused on the energy, petrochemicals, and infrastructure sectors. The company provides a range of services, including plant design, engineering, procurement, construction, and project management, with a focus on sustainability and energy transition solutions. Maire Tecnimont is headquartered in Milan, Italy.
